issues.issue: Was the RAD's internal flight alternative finding reasonable on whether the agent could locate the applicants through data and technology?
issues.applicant_position: OCEZ could use corrupt police, technology, data breaches and social media to locate them in IFAs.
issues.respondent_position: Failure to cite the updated document is irrelevant; applicants lack evidence OCEZ used such data to track them.
issues.result_text: RAD ignored updated National Document Package item 14.1 on data breaches; unreasonable; remitted to different panel.
